offering_description.value: Provides integrated financial data, analytics, research workflow tools and portfolio software to investment professionals, banks, asset managers and wealth firms. Delivered mainly through subscription-based desktop, web, data feed and API platforms. Also offers data management and outsourced services.

primary_products.value: financial data feeds; analytics software; portfolio analytics platforms; research workstation software; data APIs

primary_services.value: data management and integration; managed analytics and reporting; wealth advisory technology support; ESG and research content delivery

customer_segment.value: B2B: asset managers, investment banks, wealth managers, hedge funds, asset owners, corporations

end_markets.value: asset management; investment banking; wealth management; hedge funds; private equity

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring annual subscriptions to data, analytics and workstation platforms; service fees: managed services and data integration

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: aggregates third-party and proprietary data into analytics platforms sold to financial institutions; service provider: data and analytics content delivery to investment firms

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: market data, analytics, portfolio software and wealth workflow tools for financial professionals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to financial institutions; online: web platforms, data feeds and APIs; partners / resellers: data marketplace and technology partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy, data licensing and financial benchmark/ESG data rules, some SEC oversight as public company
